articles.title: Zoning Board Hears Plan for Bus Shelter Near Stonebridge
articles.deck: The vote came after 30 residents spoke at Monday’s session.
body: Residents of Stonebridge said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Councilmember Helena Caruso asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $7,500. Public works estimates the work will take about 30 weeks once it starts in April.
